Balances.description: Which balance-sheet amounts the ratios use (SPEC-0007 R2). No default: the analyst chooses.

oneOf.description: Balances at the end of the period (`closing`).
Average of the opening and closing balances: (opening + closing) / 2. Needs `opening`.

DebtBasis.description: What D measures in the leverage form of the ROE decomposition. No default.

oneOf.description: Net financial position (gross debt minus cash and other items, as the analyst defines it).

LeverageInputs.description:
Inputs of the leverage form ROE = [ROI + (ROI − i) × D/E] × (1 − t). The debt D itself is
given in the balance sheets (`debt`), so the balance convention applies to it.

financial_charges.description: Financial charges of the period, in currency units; i = financial charges / D.

pre_tax_income.description: Income before taxes of the period, in currency units.

taxes.description: Income taxes of the period, in currency units; t = taxes / pre-tax income.

OperatingReturnBase.description: The capital on which the operating return (ROI) and the capital turnover are measured.

oneOf.description: Operating invested capital (`invested_capital` in the balance sheets).
Total assets (`total_assets` in the balance sheets).

ProfitabilityBalances.description: Balance-sheet amounts at one date, in currency units.

debt.description:
Debt D of the leverage form, in currency units, on the basis chosen in
`leverage.debt_basis`. Required when `leverage` is given; not used otherwise.

equity.description: Shareholders' equity, in currency units. May be negative.

invested_capital.description:
Operating invested capital, in currency units. Required when `operating_return_base` is
`invested_capital`; not used otherwise.

ProfitabilityIncome.description: Flows of the period, in currency units.

ebit.description: EBIT (operating result) of the period, in currency units.

ebitda.description: EBITDA of the period, in currency units, as defined in `ebitda_definition`.

net_income.description: Net income of the period, in currency units.

revenue.description: Revenue of the period, in currency units.

balances.description: Balances used by the ratios: `closing`, or `average` of opening and closing.

closing.description: Balance sheet at the end of the period.

ebitda_definition.description:
How EBITDA was measured, in words (for example "reported EBITDA, no adjustments");
echoed in the conventions.

leverage.description:
Inputs of the leverage form of the ROE decomposition. Absent: the leverage form is not
defined and the other ratios are computed.

opening.description:
Balance sheet at the start of the period. Required with average balances; not used
with closing balances.

operating_return_base.description: Capital on which ROI and the capital turnover are measured.
